Products and Leads — Requirements

The User Journeys
 must be adhered to.

The tables below list the validation rules and operational requirements that apply to Products and Leads. The Validated by
 column indicates where each rule is enforced. All requests require an active Trust Framework application
 with the BDSP
 role, a valid transport certificate
 presented on every request via mTLS, and an active signing key
 for JWT signing.

chunks.text:
Products and Leads — Requirements > Retrieve Product Data

The Products API does not require user consent. The TPP authenticates using a client credentials grant and calls each LFI individually. All LFI GET /products
 requests must be made in parallel unless the User has specifically filtered out (de-selected) individual LFIs.

Field | Rule | Validated by
Authorization | Must contain a valid Bearer access token obtained via a client_credentials
 grant with products
 scope. | API Hub
x-fapi-customer-ip-address | Required.
 Must be included on every GET /products
 request to prove that the User is present in the interaction. Must be a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address. | TPP
x-fapi-interaction-id | Should be included. Should be a valid UUID (RFC 4122). An invalid value will not cause a failure but tracing will not be possible. | N/A
OpenAPI schema | The request must conform to the GET /products
 OpenAPI schema
. No additional or undocumented parameters are permitted. | API Hub
Application fields (ApplicationUri
, ApplicationPhoneNumber
, ApplicationEmail
, ApplicationDescription
) | Every product returned must include at least one
 of the application fields, so the TPP always has a path for the end user to apply. Where multiple are populated, ApplicationUri
 is the preferred channel. | LFI

chunks.text:
Products and Leads — Requirements > Submit a Lead

The Leads API allows a TPP to refer a User to a specific LFI when the User wishes further information about a specific product or wishes the LFI to contact them.

Field | Rule | Validated by
Authorization | Must contain a valid Bearer access token obtained via a client_credentials
 grant with products
 scope. | API Hub
x-fapi-customer-ip-address | Required.
 Must be included on every POST /leads
 request. Must be a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address. | TPP
x-fapi-interaction-id | Should be included. Should be a valid UUID (RFC 4122). An invalid value will not cause a failure but tracing will not be possible. | N/A
OpenAPI schema | The request must conform to the POST /leads
 OpenAPI schema
. | API Hub
